fun_facts.text: The first movie theater in the world was opened in 1895 in Paris, France.
The largest rooftop garden in the world is located in Chicago, USA.
The first trampoline was invented in the 1930s by a man named George Nissen.
The first amusement park in the world was opened in 1583 in Denmark.
The concept of a flying house has been around since the 17th century, but it's still not possible with current technology.
